bizInvoicesEmpty: No invoices yet. Create a professional invoice in under a minute.
bizFreeLeft: {count, plural, one{{count} free invoice left} other{{count} free invoices left}}
invRateUnavailable: The NBS rate for this date isn't available yet.
invDeleteConfirm: Delete invoice {number}? This can't be undone.

invNotInVat: The issuer is not registered for VAT.
invValidWithoutStamp: This invoice is valid without a stamp or signature.
invQrHint: Your client scans the QR code in their bank app — amount, account and reference fill in automatically.
invQrReasonAccount: add a valid Serbian bank account in Business details
invQrReasonOther: check the business name and payment reference
invErrorItems: Add at least one item with a description and price.
invErrorDue: The due date can't be before the issue date.
profIntro: Printed on your invoices and, if you choose, on PDF reports.
profVatHint: Adds VAT lines to invoices. When off, invoices state that you're not in the VAT system.
profPaymentCode: Payment code for the QR (šifra plaćanja)
profPaymentCodeHint: 221 for payments for goods and services
profShowOnReports: Show business details on PDF reports
profInvalidPib: The PIB check digit doesn't match — please check it.
profInvalidMb: The registration number check digit doesn't match.
profInvalidAccount: The account number check digits don't match.
pausalIntro: Flat-rate (paušal) entrepreneurs lose the regime above 6,000,000 RSD of revenue in a calendar year and must register for VAT above 8,000,000 RSD in any 12 months.
pausalProjection: At this pace you'll invoice about {amount} by 31 December.
pausalProjectionOver: At this pace you'll pass the paušal limit before year-end (about {amount}).
pausalWarn: You've used more than 80% of this limit.
pausalOver: Limit exceeded — talk to your accountant.
pausalMissingRate: {count, plural, one{{count} foreign-currency invoice has no NBS rate and isn't counted.} other{{count} foreign-currency invoices have no NBS rate and aren't counted.}}
pausalSourceInvoices: Counted from issued and paid invoices (by date of supply) plus revenue you add below.
pausalManualEmpty: Add invoices you issued elsewhere this year to keep the totals complete.
mrgMarginHint: Margin is profit as a share of the price; markup is profit as a share of the cost.
mrgImpossible: A margin of 100% or more isn't possible.
beImpossible: The price must be higher than the variable cost per unit.
invsNoIrr: No IRR for these cash flows
invsGood: Creates value at a {rate} discount rate.
invsBad: Destroys value at a {rate} discount rate.
profInvalidAccountShape: Enter a Serbian account (160-0000000000000-00) or an IBAN.
profInvalidPaymentCode: Use a three-digit payment code, e.g. 221.
profPrivacy: Stored only on this phone. It is included in backups you export.
profIbanHint: Printed on foreign-currency invoices. Leave empty to use your account above in IBAN form.
profInvalidIban: Check the IBAN — the check digits don't match.
profInvalidSwift: A SWIFT/BIC code has 8 or 11 characters.
invSefNote: Invoices to the Serbian public sector — and, for VAT payers, to Serbian companies — must also go through SEF (e-Faktura). Bilans invoices suit clients abroad, individuals and your own records.
invRateOffline: Couldn't reach the NBS. Check your connection — you can also save now and fetch the rate later.
invCompleteFirst: Add the client and at least one item before issuing.
invCancelBody: It stays in your list, marked as cancelled, and no longer counts as revenue.
invRateMissingNote: No NBS rate yet — this invoice isn't counted toward your paušal limits until it has one.
pausalMonthlyRoom: To stay under the limit, keep to about {amount} a month until the end of the year.
pausalDisclaimer: Revenue is counted by the date of supply. Foreign-currency invoices use the NBS middle rate on the issue date. Check the final figures with your accountant.
vatEmpty: Enter an amount to split it into the net amount and VAT.
vatRatesNote: Rates shown are the standard and reduced VAT rates in {country}.
mrgEmpty: Enter the cost and a price, markup or margin.
mrgLoss: At this price you sell below cost.
beEmpty: Enter your fixed costs, price and variable cost per unit.
beExplain: Each unit sold contributes its price minus its variable cost toward fixed costs and profit. Amounts are without VAT.
invsFlowsHint: Net cash flow at the end of each year. Type a minus sign for a year with more going out than coming in.
invsEmpty: Enter the investment, a discount rate and at least one year's cash flow.
